name: hollow candy
description: Sticky, sweet and faintly cursed. Widow Hessa at the crossroads of the Haunted Harvest trades for it.

name: sexton's key
description: An old bone key of the village sexton. Use it on the crypt seal in the ruined chapel of the Haunted Harvest.

name: ritual candle
description: A black candle of the hedge witches. Three of them, set on the ritual circle under the chapel, open the way to the Hollow King.

name: hollow charm
description: A carved charm of the Haunted Harvest. Use it to unlock a haunted cosmetic for your account (one your account does not own yet).
